I am very satisfied with the high level of skill and the finished result!

The very polite service and relaxing atmosphere of the salon are wonderful.

Thank you for taking care of my dog's hair type 😊

I will definitely use your services again.

I always use your services.

The shop is clean and the customer service is attentive, so my dog ​​is always happy after grooming. 🐶 …

I had my dog ​​looked after for about four hours. After picking him up, they sent me photos and videos, so I could see that my dog ​​had a good time. I could really tell that the staff love dogs. Thank you very much.

It's a very clean place, and a comfortable space for dogs to spend time in. 
Staff members are always there to play with them, so there's no need to worry about them getting bored.

The service was excellent and attentive!

My dog ​​also got a beautiful haircut!
Thank you for your continued support. You have a wide variety of toys, and it's conveniently located near my house.
I ordered the optional menu items again this time. I'm getting more familiar with the restaurant, and it was a refreshing and clean experience♪ Thank you very much. I would like to order again ^_^

I recently had my dog ​​groomed here, and the staff were all incredibly kind and attentive. I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care.
The shop had a very calming and clean atmosphere, and my dog ​​seemed very relaxed.
I was extremely happy with the result; her face looked neat and tidy, making her even cuter!
I'm so grateful for the staff's skill and kindness.
I would definitely like to use their services again next time.
Thank you so much!
This is our first time here! The kind lady groomed Monica while talking to her, and she seemed relaxed and happy. Thank you♪

They were polite and friendly.
The finished product was cute and I'm very happy.

The salon was very clean and had a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The staff were friendly and attentive to my pet, so I felt at ease leaving him in their care.

The cut and shampoo services were particularly excellent. The cut was styled to bring out my pet's individuality, and the shampoo was done with careful care, leaving my pet's coat feeling noticeably shinier. I was very happy with the results, and my pet seemed very comfortable.

Overall, the salon stood out for its professional skills and warm service. I would definitely use it again.

Thank you for visiting Pets Tokyo Iidabashi and for your review!

We offer a wide variety of optional services, so we hope you will take advantage of them the next time you visit!

Once again, we thank you for your review.
All of our staff look forward to welcoming you back.

Everyone we met at the nursery school was so kind and welcoming, which made us very happy.

She loved the nursery school, especially the teachers, so much that she quickly memorized the route.

She would even run to get there when she realized we were heading to nursery school, and she would try to go even on days when it wasn't a nursery school day. She would even cry when it was time to leave because she didn't want to be separated.

She was just starting to learn that it was okay because she would see them again. So, more than anything, we're thinking about how we'll respond when she notices something is wrong or she feels lonely... We'll think about it carefully as a family and try to support her.

I took advantage of the Inutomo campaign. Despite traveling all the way from Sendai, I received kind and courteous service, and the shop was new and clean, so I felt at ease leaving my dog ​​there. For pet owners visiting Tokyo Dome, Korakuen Hall, or the surrounding area, I recommend leaving your dog at PetsTokyo Iidabashi while you run your errands, and then enjoying sightseeing in Tokyo with your dog for the rest of the time, making your trip more meaningful. I would also like to use their services again when I visit Tokyo.

They had everything: pet hotel, daycare, and grooming!

The staff were all very kind, so I felt completely at ease leaving my pet there!

Since it's near Tokyo Dome, I thought it was the perfect place to kill time while my pet was getting groomed!

I also got to see the pet hotel rooms, and they had spacious individual rooms for small to large dogs—so comfortable, you could almost live in them!

I'd definitely like to use their services next time I travel!

I found the shop right away!

I treated my dog ​​to a self-service shampoo!
The place was clean and had a nice atmosphere. I could see my dog ​​from outside, so I felt at ease leaving him there.
